entities.title: transfers-service
entities.text: Handles instant transfers between accounts. Writes postings to the ledger and publishes TransferSettled events. Requires an idempotency key on every request.

entities.title: ledger-service
entities.text: Double-entry ledger. Amounts are integer minor units. Postings are append-only and reconciled nightly.

entities.title: transfers repository
entities.text: Clojure service code for transfers. Tests run with the shared integration harness. Feature flags via the flags library.

entities.title: POST /transfers
entities.text: Creates a transfer. Headers: Idempotency-Key (required). Body: source_account, target_account, amount_minor, currency. Returns 409 on duplicate key with different payload.

entities.title: ADR-012 Idempotency keys for money movement
entities.text: Every money-moving endpoint must accept an idempotency key, persist it for 72 hours and replay the original response on retry. Rationale: clients retry on timeouts and double postings are unrecoverable without manual reconciliation.

entities.title: Retry and timeout guidelines
entities.text: Outbound HTTP calls need explicit timeouts. Retry only idempotent operations, with jittered exponential backoff and a retry budget.

entities.title: Transfers v1 design (deprecated)
entities.text: Original transfers design without idempotency keys. Retries were handled by the client checking transfer status before retrying.

entities.title: Runbook: transfers latency and duplicate postings
entities.text: If duplicate postings are reported, check idempotency key store hit rate, then ledger reconciliation diff. Page team-payments for p95 above 800ms.

entities.title: INC-2041 duplicate transfers after gateway timeout
entities.text: A gateway timeout triggered client retries. A new endpoint skipped idempotency key validation and 312 transfers were posted twice. Root cause: missing idempotency check in transfers batch endpoint.

entities.title: PAY-881 Add idempotency to batch transfers endpoint
entities.text: Follow-up from INC-2041. Batch endpoint must validate and persist idempotency keys per item.

entities.title: Payments team
entities.text: Owns transfers, payment initiation and the transfers on-call rotation.
